claims.statement: AKSK is a shareable tool-agnostic starter kit (package.json name agent-knowledge-starter version 2.0.0) that ships markdown conventions and agent skills, has empty dependencies, no runtime service or database, and npm test intentionally fails.

OpenSpec (@fission-ai/openspec) and OpenWiki (openwiki plus openwiki --init) are peer dependencies; every skill verifies them via node .agents/skills/aksk-bootstrap/scripts/check_peer_tools.mjs and fails fast on exit 2 printing exact npm i -g install commands, while only the deterministic global orchestrator bootstrap-global.mjs installs missing tools per-user via npm i -g with caret ranges from references/versions.json via versionsFromPackageJson() — the per-repo lane bootstrap-repo.mjs never installs globals and fails fast directing to aksk-bootstrap.

Node >=22 is the single required runtime for all .mjs kit scripts under .agents/skills/aksk-bootstrap/scripts (bootstrap, bootstrap-global, check_peer_tools, attach_wiki_contract, attach_section, sync_wiki_indexes, init_agents_md, refresh_agents_baseline) and .agents/skills/aksk-init/scripts (bootstrap-repo, init_agents_md, attach_section, attach_wiki_contract) per the node-single-runtime decision.

Repository authority is split into four zones: root router (AGENTS.md with marker-delimited zones), portable prescriptive (.agents/), curated descriptive (openwiki/ decisions/troubleshooting), and process/intent (openspec/), with tooling validating all zones.

Root AGENTS.md is entrypoint-routed via marker-delimited managed sections ordered AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE then OPENWIKI:START/END then AKSK:ROUTING and AKSK:LIFECYCLE; baseline is owned by init_agents_md.mjs/refresh_agents_baseline.mjs (canonical in aksk-init), routing and lifecycle markers are owned by attach_section.mjs (shipped under both skills, canonical per-repo owner aksk-init), which appends below existing content without replacement and preserves content outside markers.

.agents/AGENTS.md is the portable prescriptive source of truth and must stay small (no session history, long rationale, failed experiments); durable multi-step procedures belong in .agents/playbooks/ not in AGENTS.md.
.agents/sessions/ is gitignored with sessions/* and !sessions/README.md and only sessions/README.md is tracked; check-agents-structure.sh verifies this via git ls-files and git status --ignored.

Each task-closeout session folder is a sortable label YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-short-topic (not canonical identity); the canonical task identifier is task_id in summary.json and each bundle must contain summary.json, active-task.md, learning-candidate.md, changed-files.txt and validation.txt.

Curated descriptive knowledge lives only as OKF pages under openwiki/ (decisions/ with aksk_status accepted/superseded/provisional, troubleshooting/, overview.md and maintenance-format.md) and carries AKSK extensions aksk_superseded_by and aksk_depends_on with qualified refs decisions/<slug> or troubleshooting/<slug>.

attach_wiki_contract.mjs appends the section from references/wiki-contract-template.md between AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers to an existing openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md, never creates the file, exits 2 with openwiki --init remediation when missing, is idempotent/self-updating, and detects the default stub.

attach_section.mjs provides one mechanism for N marker-delimited root sections (routing-note-template.md AKSK:ROUTING and lifecycle-template.md AKSK:LIFECYCLE), reads markers from the template, is idempotent and self-updating, preserves content outside markers, creates a missing target file containing only the section, and exits 2 on unknown template.

sync_wiki_indexes.mjs refreshes all OpenWiki directory indexes deterministically without invoking openwiki --update or an LLM by locating the global openwiki package via npm root -g, importing agent/docs-only-backend.js and okf/index-sync.js, constructing OpenWikiLocalShellBackend with docsOnly true and virtualMode true, and calling synchronizeWikiIndexes; it exits 2 when openwiki/ is uninitialized or the package is missing.

scripts/check-agents-structure.sh validates target existence, required files (AGENTS.md, .gitignore, playbooks/README.md, sessions/README.md, four SKILL.md files and task-closeout example bundle), session tracking (only README tracked), SKILL.md YAML frontmatter name/description, and JSON validity via jq when available.

scripts/check-publish.sh is the release hygiene wrapper (exposed as npm run check) that delegates to check-agents-structure.sh and additionally runs remark formatting, markdown-link-check per file, rg secret and path leakage scans, and doubled .agents/.agents path hygiene, degrading to warnings when optional tools are absent.

Maintenance loop comprises four phases with distinct write ownership: task-closeout captures evidence only under .agents/sessions/, learning-distill classifies and promotes to .agents/ or openwiki/ curated trees, sync_wiki_indexes.mjs deterministically refreshes indexes, and docs-lint performs periodic coherence checks.

learning-distill fails closed requiring peer tools on PATH and openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md to carry AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers before any wiki writes, classifies lessons into ephemeral/AGENTS guidance/playbook/decision record/troubleshooting record/descriptive lesson, never invokes openwiki --update, validates pages at runtime via openwiki/dist/okf/frontmatter.js and loads authoring guidance from openwiki/dist/agent/prompt.js.

docs-lint wiring checks fail the pass for damaged or duplicated routing blocks (including AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE provenance), missing wiki curation contract, archived openspec/changes/archive entries without openwiki coverage or recorded deferral, and stale curated pages with dead dependencies or superseded status; content checks only report duplication, contradictions, broken links, frontmatter violations and path hygiene, and lint never writes OpenWiki-owned files.

Invariants enforced by lint and distillation: durable descriptive knowledge lives only in curated openwiki/ pages while .agents/ holds only prescriptive guidance, and candidate decisions that duplicate SHALL requirements already codified in openspec/specs/ must cite the spec instead of creating a wiki page.

This repository is the starter kit rooted in its own .agents/ as source of truth for generic templates; a consumer's .agents/ becomes the contract after adoption and there is no example/ distribution path — shipped install lanes are agent-assisted via bootstrap and fallback npx skills add per install-lanes spec.

bootstrap.mjs is a compat shim that sequentially runs bootstrap-global.mjs then aksk-init bootstrap-repo.mjs via spawnSync, exiting with the first non-zero status; bootstrap-global.mjs is global-only (preflight Node major, tools on PATH, .agents/openspec/openwiki trees, openwiki integrations list receipts; verifies CLIs via per-user npm i -g at caret ranges from references/versions.json via versionsFromPackageJson() skipping present tools) and never half-installs (failed step prints exact INSTRUCT remaining commands with no partial state), while skill spread via npx skills add and host integrations are orchestrated by the aksk-bootstrap skill agent as manual opt-in rather than auto-installed by the script; bootstrap-repo.mjs is per-repo-only (scaffold .agents plus baseline first, openspec init, openwiki --init, routing/lifecycle and contract attachment) and never installs globals.

init_agents_md.mjs seeds a missing root AGENTS.md with the vendored FerroxLabs baseline wrapped in AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE markers with provenance header, is idempotent when the marked section matches, exits 2 with no writes on existing non-matching files, supports --replace to overwrite and --combine to stage existing plus baseline under .agents/sessions/agents-md-combine/<timestamp>/, and refresh_agents_baseline.mjs fetches upstream and swaps only that marker zone.

Shipped install lanes are agent-assisted npx skills add Hypercubed/Agent-Knowledge-Starter-Kit into the canonical user store (~/.agents/skills universal plus self-reported host via -g -a, npx required, no clone fallback per canonical-user-skills-scope spec) and deterministic node .agents/skills/aksk-bootstrap/scripts/bootstrap.mjs EXECUTE/INSTRUCT delegating to bootstrap-global then bootstrap-repo, with npx skills add plus per-skill initialization as fallback per install-lanes spec; example/ remains unsupported, and openspec/changes/add-task-start (task-start seeding summary.json before closeout) remains proposal-only and must not be presented as shipped.
